$about: Every place the site departs from a rule on purpose, or holds a stand-in, with who decided, when and why, and the fix if it is reconsidered. build/rules.mjs reads it: a CSS rule that uses screen units (vw, vh, svh, cqi) passes only if a decision here lists its selector under css. build/audit.mjs reads it: an exception with an audit entry is not a failure, but is measured and printed under «Kept as designed» on every run.
kind: decision = a deliberate choice; exception = it breaks a rule of the system and is kept; placeholder = a stand-in until the real thing arrives (each one is in the report's «Next» list).

decisions.what: Headings and names are set in PT Mono Bold, as in Figma (self-hosted, cut to the text face's characters: 13 KB)
decisions.why: the file came from Tim in round 3; its ParaType Free Font Licence allows embedding on web pages. Rounds 1–2 used JetBrains Mono Bold in its place

decisions.what: From L the footer is two equal halves, each at least a square: the animated flame centred on the left one by its mass (measured over its animation: 50.5% across, 62.9% down its box), the newsletter and the links on the right. Square from about 1360px wide; narrower, the links need more height than the square has and both halves grow with them (1280: 599 × 626)
decisions.why: Tim, round 3: «2 square-ratio containers», «the logo should be optically centered». The mass centre lifts the flame by 12% of its height, as the Figma footer's 40px lift of a 320px logo does

decisions.what: The recommended row runs out to the screen's edges (scripts/slider.js measures the column's margins into --bleed-l/-r), padded back so its cards stand and snap on the column; cards rise into place from below as they come into view
decisions.why: Tim, round 3: «the wrapper of the cards should not crop them», «the new card should move into place from below and opacity 0». A rising card is transformed and translucent for 0.9s, so for that time it is a stacking context and its pack (faded with it: pouch3d alpha) draws above its name and buy row

decisions.what: Every new arrival shows a photo; a coffee without its own (photos.bySlug) shows the next of four moodboard photos (site.json featured.photos)
decisions.why: Tim, round 3: «the right column should contain a photo»; only four coffees have a photo
decisions.fix: a photo per coffee in photos.bySlug; then featured.photos can go

decisions.what: Pages cross-fade (cross-document view transitions); a card opening its coffee carries its name and pack to the page's title and big pack. For the capture the packs show their stills. Chrome 126+, Safari 18.2+; elsewhere a page simply opens. public/vt.js, a plain script in <head>, names the parts
decisions.why: Tim, round 3: «a card on a click should transform into a product page seamlessly». The script has to run before the first frame, which Vite's module bundle does not

decisions.what: The three info blocks are buttons that grow into one modal (Figma info-blocks-modal): a box of --modal-w in the middle of the dimmed screen, a sheet at the foot of a phone's; it steps to the other blocks; the text of the roast block names the next roast live
decisions.why: Tim, round 3. The ground grows (an empty box may scale), the icon and title travel at their size, the plus turns into the cross: nothing is stretched. While it is open the page stops scrolling and keeps its scrollbar's room as padding (--sbw), so nothing behind it moves

decisions.what: The countdown digits are Technology Bold, subset to 0–9 and the colon (1.2 KB)
decisions.why: the font of the Figma hero; the file came from Tim

decisions.what: Every 3D pack shows the label of Индонезия Суматра Паллунг
decisions.why: only that label exists as art; products.json gives every coffee art: sumatra-front/back
decisions.fix: export each coffee's label at 512 and 1024 px (front and back) into public/pack/labels/<slug>-…, and set art in build/data.mjs to the slug

decisions.what: Prices are placeholders by price group and weight (data/prices.json: Classic 250 / 680 / 2600 ₽ for 50 г / 200 г / 1 кг, Citric 290 / 780 / 2900, Special 390 / 1180 / 4400)
decisions.why: the price table has no prices
decisions.fix: real prices into data/prices.json (or a price column into the table) and placeholder: false

decisions.what: The photos are the Figma moodboard's: several show other roasters' packs (SIP, Cafe Public, Paloma, Stereoscope, MARU) and none is QQ's own; they are renders exported from Figma at 1280–1440 px
decisions.why: no other pictures yet
decisions.fix: QQ's own photos into assets-src/img under the same names, npm run images

decisions.what: The hero shows a still of the Figma video (13456698-hd_1920_1080_30fps), drifting slowly, 1280 px wide
decisions.why: the video file is not in the Figma file's exports
decisions.fix: the video (WebM/MP4, about 1 MB, muted, loop) in place of the still, the still as its poster

decisions.what: The countdown and the catalog's shipping line assume roasting on weekdays at 10:00 Moscow time
decisions.why: Figma shows a countdown but no schedule
decisions.fix: the real days and hour in data/site.json roast

decisions.what: The texts of the info blocks' modal for payment and delivery were written for the site (the roasting one is Figma's)
decisions.why: Figma's modal shows only the roasting block's text
decisions.fix: the real text in data/site.json facts

decisions.what: The bag, the favourites, the ratings and the checkout keep everything in the visitor's browser (localStorage, sessionStorage for the checkout); nothing is sent: the checkout's last step, the business request form, «Добавить» an address and «Выйти» say so in a toast
decisions.why: there is no shop, accounts or CRM behind the site yet; the pages (round 4) are built so they can be reviewed and used as far as a static site can
decisions.fix: the shop's API: the bag and the checkout post to it, the account pages read the visitor's orders from it

decisions.what: Under 48em the sections open from the burger: a menu under the bar that slides down from under it, every section a cell divided by hairlines that run its whole width, no padding of the menu's own and the gutter on all four sides of every cell (the text trimmed), no line under the last cells (the menu's own closes it); two columns filled left to right from the tab bar's step (40em) up. Its height is at most the screen's less the bars (svh)
decisions.why: Tim, round 6 (lines at full width, the paddings of the cells only and equal, no line under the last, two columns on larger screens, in from above); the two columns start where the tab bar leaves (a tablet), so a phone keeps one column of big targets

decisions.what: «Популярные» (the catalog's default order): coffees with a tag first, then Special, then the newest
decisions.why: no sales data
decisions.fix: an order field in the table

decisions.what: «Кофе с похожим вкусом»: the four coffees nearest in density, acidity, sweetness and ferment, nearer for each shared flavour family of descriptors and for the same line
decisions.why: the table has no explicit links between coffees

decisions.what: Secondary text is ink-70 (#2d2f33 at 70%), never ink-60 or ink-50 as some Figma texts are (the unchosen weight «1 кг», small numbers of the pager)
decisions.why: ink-60 is 3.8 : 1 on white and ink-50 2.9 : 1, below 4.5 : 1 for text; ink-60 stays only for large text (the inactive catalog tabs, 3 : 1) and parts of controls

decisions.what: No rounded corners: blocks, cards, buttons and fields are sharp; only pills (descriptors, the bag counter) and dots are round
decisions.why: the brand's grid of hairlines; Figma has no radius except pills

decisions.what: The navbar is 48px at every size, its links in --type-body; its own side margin is 16px (the small gutter) and its content stops at the column widened by the 8px of air inside the logo's and icons' boxes
decisions.why: a control, not a block: as in every Figma frame; Tim, round 2: the side padding «small», a systematic max width counting the air around the logo and the icons

decisions.what: The hero is the screen less a 24px peek (less the tab bar on a phone), at most --hero-max (960 → 1200); never less than its cells, the fade and --hero-photo need
decisions.why: a screen-sized block (the rule of the system: such blocks are measured by the screen's height directly); Tim, round 2: «full minus 24px» with a min and a max by screen size

decisions.what: From L the hero's title fills its cell: its longest word «обжарки» (4.55em) runs from padding to padding, so its size is the cell less its two gutters, ÷ 4.55 (the cell: a third of the column and its two gutters below the max, a third of the column from it), held between 48px and --type-hero (48 → 88), both ends on the ladder: 58px at 1024, 84 at 1440, 88 from about 1540. Below L the title is --type-hero itself. From about 1366 its three lines and their padding set the height of the cells and the countdown's and the links' three rows share it; on narrower L screens the countdown's digits are taller and lead
decisions.why: Tim, round 5: «the title should shape the height of the whole bottom container; on larger screens its size should be larger than now»; round 6: 48px at least, and its largest size on the ladder (it was 90px, off the ladder, while the report's chart showed --type-display's 64; the home title now has its own role, type/hero, and --type-display stays 40 → 64 for the business and about pages). The size follows the cell, which only a container unit (cqi of the column) knows

decisions.what: The product stage is pinned at the height of the screen less the navbar and the buy bar; the fact tiles are spaced by 40% of the screen's height (28% from L)
decisions.why: the pack turns as the tiles pass: the distance between them is scroll time, which is measured in screens

decisions.what: The countdown's digits are QQ Digits, drawn as SVG segments by the build (build/digits.mjs from Tim's settings in design/digits.json, the artifact «QQ Digits»): seven segments per digit and the colon's dots, the unlit ones shown as a trace (white 12% on black), each segment fading on in 120ms and off in 200ms. Not a font: Technology Bold is gone
decisions.why: Tim, round 6: «the program, so that we can animate the segments later». The SVG is in the page from the start (all unlit until the clock runs), so it needs no font file and works without the script

decisions.what: When the home page opens, the hero's dock rises into place over 1.4s (--t-intro; from L the whole row of cells), and inside it each cell part by part, a third of a part's 0.9s apart: the title line by line (GSAP SplitText, the lines as set at that width), the countdown row by row, the links one by one. A click, a key or a scroll ends it at once. GSAP (with SplitText and CustomEase, about 34 KB gzipped) loads only on the home page, after the page; an inline script in <head> hides the parts from the first frame, and if the script never runs they show after 3s. Nothing of it with «reduce motion»
decisions.why: Tim, round 6: «the bottom block should move in its place slower; each cell element by element: line by line for the title (use gsap), row by row for the clock, link by link»

decisions.what: From L the hero's fade into black and the hairline above its cells are layers of the cells' grid that reach the screen's edges (50% − 50vw on each side), past the frame from the column's max; the hero clips them
decisions.why: the grid is inside the content column (a container query can only style what is inside the column), but the fade and the line belong to the whole screen's width, as they did on the block around the column

decisions.what: Everything in the roast cell is as wide as its caption «До ближайшей обжарки» (13.9em of --type-control), or as wide as the cell allows where it is narrower and the caption takes two lines (below M, and between M and L where the countdown's parts stand side by side): the digits (QQ Digits, SVG, «00:00:00» 3em) fill that width, the date (more than a day to wait) fills it with its letters, 0.65em each in mono (a container unit of the digits' box)
decisions.why: Tim, round 2: «the elements should be the max width of the caption»; round 6: the countdown in two columns below M and side by side between M and L, where the one-line caption no longer fits. QQ Digits have no letters, so the date «Пт, 9 Окт» is set in the mono of the headings
decisions.audit: the caption, the digits and the day row are measured to the same width

decisions.what: Four coffees show a photo on their card instead of the 3D pack (data/site.json photos), as the Figma catalog mixes them
decisions.why: the rhythm of the Figma catalog

decisions.what: On a narrow column the buy bar stays at the foot of the screen in two rows (options; quantity, price, button)
decisions.why: Figma has the bar only at 1440; buying should stay one tap away

decisions.what: On a screen under 32em tall (a phone sideways) the buy bar waits after the product stage instead of following the screen, and the stage pins at the whole screen under the navbar (no 22rem floor)
decisions.why: measured at 844 × 390: the two-row bar took 129 of 390px and covered the pack by 139px; a pinned block must fit the screen or not pin

decisions.what: The navbar in four steps: every section (≥ 70em), four short ones «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» (≥ 48em), the burger, and under 40em a tab bar at the foot of the screen with «Каталог, Корзина, Избранное, Профиль». Every link a cell with 14px each side of its text, the cells 8px apart
decisions.why: Tim, round 2 (the steps), round 6 (an even hover ground, 8px between the links); the widths are where each row fits with room to spare (measured: the eight cells take 708px, so the full row needs about 1120px, was 1024 with 16px between the texts; the short row 360px at 768)
decisions.decided: Tim, 2026-10-20 (the steps, rounds 2 and 6); Claude (the widths)

decisions.what: Navbar and tab-bar items link only to pages that exist: the catalog, «Кофейням» / «Бизнесу» (business/), «Контакты», favourites, bag and profile do; «Каскара», «Дрипы», «Сеты», «Офисам», «Журнал» and search are labels without a link
decisions.why: Tim, round 2: «links to pages, not anchors; if there's no page, don't add any link»
decisions.fix: a page for each: add its path as the second value in data/site.json nav

decisions.what: The navbar (and the tab bar) take the colours of the section under them, changing once wholly over it, on --t-move; above the top of the page they keep the first section's
decisions.why: Tim, round 2

decisions.what: Hover on a control (the navbar's links and icons, the tab bar, the hero's links and «i», the pager's numbers, the arrows, a card's two cells and its heart): a tint behind the one item, white at 20% on dark grounds, ink at 6% on light ones (white would not show on white); nothing moves. A pointer's focus changes nothing; the keyboard's draws the ring
decisions.why: Tim, round 2: «semi-transparent white, not affecting other elements»; round 5: «these elements on hover should change the color of the container to semi-transparent cool gray or white… in the focused state nothing should be changed», «the icon shouldn't move», «the picture should not move on hover»
decisions.decided: Tim, 2026-10-20 (rounds 2 and 5); Claude (the light-ground tint, the keyboard's ring kept)

decisions.what: Every hairline is var(--line): cool grey at 20% on light grounds, white at 30% on dark ones; only states (the current dot of the pager, a field focused from the keyboard) draw a border in ink
decisions.why: Tim, round 2: «borders always cool gray 20% on light and white 30% on dark»

decisions.what: The account pages show a made-up visitor, «Марк Новиков» of Figma, with six orders (data/account.json); every number on them (lots, processes, Q, countries, descriptors, the taste profile, beans, totals) is worked out from those orders and the catalog by src/templates/account-data.mjs
decisions.why: there are no accounts yet; Figma's numbers did not add up (an order of three coffees at 680 ₽ for 1095 ₽), so the pages compute them
decisions.fix: read the signed-in visitor's orders from the shop and drop data/account.json

decisions.what: Delivery prices and the free-delivery threshold: courier 415 ₽, pickup 240 ₽, 1–2 days, free from 1 799 ₽ (data/site.json shop)
decisions.why: Figma shows 415 ₽ in the bag and 490 ₽ in the checkout for the same courier; one value everywhere
decisions.fix: the real CDEK prices (or the CDEK calculator) in data/site.json shop

decisions.what: Of the 15 questions of «Вопросы и ответы» Figma answers one («Как выбрать кофе?»); the other 14 answers are written from what the site already says (delivery, payment, the roast) and marked placeholder in data/faq.json
decisions.why: the page needs answers to work
decisions.fix: the real answers in data/faq.json, placeholder removed

decisions.what: The business page keeps the copywriter's blanks of Figma visible: [чемпионат, год], [название], [N] лотов, [N] минут
decisions.why: inventing them would put false claims on the site

decisions.what: The privacy policy keeps the blanks of its Figma text: ОГРНИП [указать], ИНН [указать], адрес [указать]; it names qqcoffee@mail.ru while the contacts name sales@qqcoffee.ru
decisions.why: legal details must come from the company, not be guessed
decisions.fix: the details and one address for requests in data/privacy.json, checked by a lawyer

decisions.what: The team portraits of «О компании» are the Figma stock photos (Pexels); Figma repeats seven people twice, the site shows each once. The Instagram strip has no link (Figma gives no account address)
decisions.why: no team photos yet
decisions.fix: the team's photos into assets-src/img (team-*.png), npm run images; the account address into data/about.json instagram.href

decisions.what: The two maps of the contacts are pictures from Figma (both crops of one map screenshot, not of the real addresses); each links to its address on Yandex Maps
decisions.why: an embedded map would need a third-party script and a CSP exception
decisions.fix: a static map image of each real address (Yandex Static API) in assets-src/img/map-office.png and map-plant.png

decisions.what: Pages drawn with older colours or styles in Figma follow the system instead: the bag's cards are the cloud squares of the catalog's half cards (Figma: a warm photo ground and hairlines #c0c1c2 at 30%), the orange roast line of the bag is ink-70, the purple «Заявка» button of the business page is white on ink, the green «Доставлен» is ink (lavender stays the state of an order on its way), radii of 4px are sharp
decisions.why: Tim, round 4: «some pages use older colours or other things — be systematic»
decisions.decided: Tim, 2026-10-20 (the rule, round 4: «be systematic»); Claude (each case)

decisions.what: The drawings of the account (the beans' ring, the taste profile, the countries, the descriptors, the beans by month) mark data in lavender, on white over the cloud tiles
decisions.why: as in Figma; a mark of data is not a surface, so it does not break «lavender is never a surface»

decisions.what: The headings inside the privacy policy and its summary are Apercu Bold, not mono capitals
decisions.why: as in Figma: long legal headings («6. Порядок сбора, хранения, передачи…») would be walls in mono capitals; they are part of the text, not names

decisions.what: The account's tabs are pages (Профиль, Заказы, Покупки, Настройки); «Активность» is a label without a link, as it is a part of the profile; «Зернышки» opens as a dialog over the profile, and account/beans/ is the same profile with the dialog open (Back closes it)
decisions.why: Figma draws «Активность» as a tab but no page for it, and «Зернышки» as a dialog
decisions.fix: a page for the activity if one is designed

decisions.what: The checkout is three addresses: checkout/ (sign-in by phone or email), checkout/details/ (for yourself or as a gift), checkout/delivery/ (city and CDEK); what was typed is kept for the visit (sessionStorage), and «Заказать в подарок» opens the gift
decisions.why: Figma «Оформление заказа» has these three sections; addresses let Back work
